title: Shreveport area work and Louisiana bands
summary: He worked in Shreveport, Alexandria and Baton Rouge, with Terry Shand in the Youngberg-Marin hotel band; mentions Louisiana Ramblers, the Dequeers and Monk Hazel.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: No, he got boys from here. Mm-hmm. I met Sharky, they all used to come over there on Sundays to hear us. Oh, yeah.
Do you remember a piano player around in Beaumont, mostly, I think he was, called Lazy Daddy? No. He was a colored guy?
Yeah, I just wondered, because he, I think, worked around with different people. You worked in several places in Louisiana, haven't you, other than New Orleans?

Yeah, Sweetport. And, uh, when I was working out of Sweetport, we sort of met in headquarters up there, worked in, uh, old Alexander and, uh, and Baton Rouge, all around. Uh, I've been around Sweetport there for quite a while.
Did they have, uh, some pretty good musicians around there that your name is outstanding?
No. No. I have a, we're about the only jazz band around there.
And who was with you after that?
